name: WinoBias
description: A benchmark for evaluating gender bias in coreference resolution systems. Contains sentences with gender-stereotyped occupations where pronoun coreference can reflect either pro-stereotypical or anti-stereotypical bias.
general_score_metric: accuracy difference between pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical examples
typical_sota_score: near equal accuracy on both types for debiased models
reputation: Key benchmark for measuring gender bias in NLP; widely cited in fairness literature; used in evaluating coreference and language models
notes: Type 1 sentences require syntactic reasoning; Type 2 sentences require semantic reasoning. Widely used alongside WinoGender. Measures how much models rely on gender stereotypes.
